usage: The phrase '打乒乓波' is used to describe the activity of playing table tennis.
'打乒乓波' can be used in both casual and formal conversations about sports.
You can use '打乒乓波' with time expressions to talk about when you play table tennis, e.g. '我星期六打乒乓波'.
In sentences, '打乒乓波' usually functions as a verb phrase without additional particles.
'打乒乓波' can also be combined with modal verbs to express ability or intention, e.g. '我識打乒乓波' (I know how to play table tennis).
